programme.desc: El 20 de septiembre de 2020 se cumplió el centenario de la creación de la Legión Española por el rey Alfonso XIII, bajo el nombre de Tercios de Extranjeros. Desde entonces, miles de hombres, españoles y extranjeros, han servido bajo la bandera de España, participando en numerosos conflictos, desde las guerras del siglo XX hasta las misiones internacionales iniciadas en los Balcanes en 1992. Un recorrido por cien años de historia marcados por el combate, el sacrificio y el valor de sus legionarios, reconocidos con numerosas condecoraciones militares por sus acciones heroicas.

programme.title: Hosteltur - Economía y turismo
programme.desc: El turismo en España y Baleares continúa creciendo, pero el sector se enfrenta a importantes retos: el aumento de los costes, la presión sobre los márgenes empresariales, el encarecimiento del empleo y el absentismo laboral. ¿Es posible generar más riqueza sin aumentar la llegada de turistas? ¿Cómo afectaría una crisis económica internacional a nuestro principal motor económico? Un análisis de los desafíos y el futuro de la industria turística.

Los VIPs vendrán acompañados por sus mejores amigos y compañeros de casa y de vida: personalidades del mundo de la comedia, la televisión, la radio y otros ámbitos de interés. VIPchos está conducido por Jorge Guerra, veterinario, cómico y guionista, y por Sara Escudero, actriz y cómica; dos apasionados de los perros y del mundo animal en general. Durante treinta minutos de charla saldrán a la luz historias sobre la relación entre los invitados, secretos, manías y, sobre todo, la maravillosa conexión que existe entre un perro y su acompañante de vida.

Visitamos Son Mesquidassa, una finca emblemática donde tradición, paisaje y sabor se funden en cada gota de su exquisito aceite de oliva virgen extra. Acompáñanos mientras aprendemos cómo se cultivan los olivos, se elabora este tesoro gastronómico, y por qué el aceite de Mallorca es mucho más que un ingrediente: es parte de la identidad isleña.

Por la noche, es Daredevil, un héroe enmascarado que vigila las oscuras calles de la ciudad y lucha contra toda clase de injusticias.

Un viaje por su patrimonio, sus calles y los lugares que hacen de Palma una ciudad única.

programme.title: Volando por Europa - Italia - Toscana
programme.desc: Vincent se adentra en la belleza de la Toscana con Alessandro como guía. Después de una visita a San Gimignano, aterrizan en Florencia para jugar al "Calcio Storico", el ancestro del fútbol donde la lucha feroz forma parte de las reglas. Después se dirigen hacia Volterra donde Vincent explora la elegancia de los etruscos - una antigua civilización que remonta a 1000 antes de Cristo.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: La memoria de Leonard, un investigador de una agencia de seguros, está irreversiblemente dañada debido a un golpe sufrido en la cabeza cuando intentaba evitar el asesinato de su mujer: éste es el último hecho que recuerda del pasado. La memoria reciente la ha perdido: los hechos cotidianos desaparecen de su mente en unos minutos. Así pues, para investigar e intentar vengar el asesinato de su esposa tiene que recurrir a la ayuda de una cámara instantánea y a las notas tatuadas en su cuerpo.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: “Special Operations” are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: As warfare has evolved, many military techniques and technologies have been adapted for use in urban settings by police units around the world. This episode provides viewers with an intimate perspective on what it feels like to be “inside the heads” of special police personnel, and how their use of military-style strategies and equipment allows them to save lives. From riot control in South Africa and the lessons learned from its excesses, to Los Angeles Police Chief Robert Gates’ creation of an elite police S.W.A.T team, CQB will showcase how, over the past 30 years, the fight against urban crime has evolved into a military scenario, with both sides using increasingly complex weaponry and tactics.

programme.title: Harry &amp; Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S09:E02 - York Castle Museum Part 2
programme.desc: Karl enters the cells, said to have once held the infamous Dick Turpin, while Stuart stays in the old street as they continue their investigation into York Castle Museum.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S09:E03 - St Georges Hall
programme.desc: Underneath St. George's Hall is a labyrinth of tunnels and rooms. Stuart ventures alone into the darkness to try and make contact with whatever haunts there.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E01 - Back In The Brooks
programme.desc: For the first time in years, the Keefer Brothers set foot on the gravel roads of remote Alaska.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E02 - Maniac Mountain
programme.desc: More than ten years on, Maniac Mountain gives the brothers another groundbreaking achievement.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E01 - Wardens Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Wardens: Case Files offers a glimpse into the remarkable stories of seasoned wildlife officers. It will transport viewers into the heart of the action, immersing them in the thrill of the chase and the satisfaction of justice served.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E02 - Moose is Loose and Lost Coast
programme.desc: A surprise guest shows up at the elementary school, giving everyone quite a scare. Meanwhile, a sneaky Angler is on the prowl, putting a twist on "catch and release." It's up to the Game Wardens to stop him.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall
programme.desc: A rock-climbing disaster hurtles climber Craig DeMartino 100 feet down a granite cliff. A shattered heap of broken bones, Craig clings to life. In a split second, Craig's life becomes an inspiring fight to survive.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S23:E07 - Ancient High House
programme.desc: The team are followed around this ancient house, said to be the haunt of many long dead spirits. The team are soon put to the test as Gregg feels something is playing with him.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E49 - Flight of the Dragon Mission Update
programme.desc: Witness this historic flight, from the first manned launch from the US in nearly a decade to the first splashdown attempt since the Apollo era.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E87 - Europa Clipper Mission to an Alien Ocean
programme.desc: Get ready for humanity's first deep dive into an alien ocean world! NASA's Europa Clipper heads to Jupiter's icy moons to explore the ultimate question: Is there life beyond Earth?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E72 - Capturing A Black Hole In Our Milky Way
programme.desc: Astronomers linked radio dishes around the world to create the “Event Horizon Telescope” and have utilized this tool to photograph a supermassive black hole in the heart of our own Milky Way Galaxy. Its name is “Sagittarius A Prime” and it is over 4 million times more massive than the Sun.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E43 - Search For Our Sun's Lost Planet
programme.desc: Is it possible that there is a hidden planet within our own solar system? New evidence suggests that the fabled Planet X, or Planet 9, may indeed exist… but where? Meet the teams racing to discover and redefine our planetary neighborhood.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E78 - Voyage Into The Sun
programme.desc: For the first time in history, NASA’s Parker Solar Probe has pierced the Sun’s corona and is orbiting above its surface. Scientists have a front-row seat to better understand the sun and predict huge solar eruptions that can cause serious damage when they hit Earth.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E01 - From There to Here
programme.desc: With the recent launch of the first privately owned space craft to service the international space station; it’s time to take a fresh look at The New frontiers of space. The sky above is littered with stars and countless galaxies. The next stage of our journey is with robotics, advanced technologies and sheer daring we are now going where before we only dreamt.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E02 - Return To The Moon
programme.desc: The Moon, our closest celestial companion. Our indispensible dance partner through the cosmos. Lighting our night sky and gently tugging at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, though her allure remains strong, once again we are glancing her way with reThe Newed interest and with a view to return very soon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E03 - The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between us and our Star, the inner worlds; hidden within the sun's glare often only visible at sunrise or sunset. Venus the first and brightest star in the evening sky, and Mercury fleeting across the solar disk. They are half of our solar system's terrestrial planets and yet as we look at our companions they are posing more questions than answers.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E04 - Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: It has fired our imaginations for millennia, Mars, the God of War and the source of Man's science fictional demise. We know the dry barren planet was once flowing with vast reservoirs of water, the sky thick and filled with clouds and the tantalizing possibility of life. It is the only other place in our solar system than Man might

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E05 - The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our Solar System four and half billion years ago there remains tantalizing clues to its evolution; remnent debris: asteroids and comets. They vary in size from grains of dust to mountain sides, footballs to planetoids. They were the building Now within our grasp these rocks of ice and dust are ready to give up their secrets.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E82 - Forecasting The Big One
programme.desc: Earthquakes can leave a path of destruction with no warning. Through the latest technology, scientists are scrambling for a breakthrough that can forecast where and when earthquakes will strike next.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E90 - Brain-Computer Interface: The Digital Mind
programme.desc: This is an inside look at how teams of scientists, engineers and surgeons—and their courageous test subjects—are using Brain-Computer Interfaces to bring hope and increased independence to patients living with conditions like paralysis, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and blindness.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E41 - Fergie The Downfall Of A Modern Duchess
programme.desc: Sarah Ferguson, once known as the Duchess of York, seemed to have everything, but her world turned upside down when her name got caught up in a big scandal.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E03 - Arctic Apex
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers end up in a showdown between a grizzly and a wolf, challenging who's really at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E04 - Valley Of Riches
programme.desc: Animals are all around us, but that doesn't make things easy.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E03 - Operation Long Tooth and Happy Kids
programme.desc: An elusive smuggler evades Game Wardens from different backgrounds. The smuggler, once discovered, has an exotic tusk in his possession. Then a story of how a dog and two amused kids leads to a bust. It's the job of Game Wardens to solve what has transpired.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E04 - Badge Bust and Beluga Whale
programme.desc: In 'Badge Bust,' one badge's over confidence gets another badge in trouble. Meanwhile, 'Beluga Whale' tells the story of a sea creature far from home that's quite the adventure.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E03 - ATV Nightmare
programme.desc: A father and son camping trip turns into a desperate fight to survive when John Sloot is crushed under an ATV. Now his 10 year-old son, Cody must brave the wilderness alone to get help.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E04 - Trapped in a Glacier
programme.desc: While hiking alone deep in Glacier National Park, Ted Porter plummets into an icy glacial crevasse. With a broken back and miles from anyone, he must fight to survive.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: After the fall of the soviet union many countries remained in dispute in the early nineties despite eastern Europe‘s independence. In 1994 a bitter conflict broke out between the forces of the Chechen independence movement and the Russian regular army. Despite overwhelming manpower, weaponry and air support, the Russian forces were unable to establish effective permanent control over the mountainous area due to many successful Chechen guerrilla raids. Improvised Explosive Devices were one of the most effective methods employed in these disastrous raids and were the back drop to many Close Quarter Battle scenarios exchanged between the two sides.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: The history of the British Empire colonial legacy in Northern Ireland is well known the world over but a there is a largely untold story of the the firefights between and close quarter battles exchanged between the provisional IRA, the British army and the elite SAS. Although the IRA often employed „terrorist“ techniques within the city of London and on England‘s mainland not much is said of the often guerilla warfare techniques of the British Special Air Service in Northern Ireland since the beginning of this conflict. In this episode we will examine how the history of the Special Air Service affected the training of every elite force after it and how the close quarter battles in Northern Ireland in the late 1970s through to the millennium shaped both special forces and resistance methods.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E33 - Prince Edward and Sophie Rhys-Jones
programme.desc: The Real Story takes us inside a simple royal love tale. It offers a glimpse behind the scenes of how a Prince ended up falling for a girl from a regular middle-class family.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E72 - Capturing A Black Hole In Our Milky Way
programme.desc: Astronomers linked radio dishes around the world to create the “Event Horizon Telescope” and have utilized this tool to photograph a supermassive black hole in the heart of our own Milky Way Galaxy. Its name is “Sagittarius A Prime” and it is over 4 million times more massive than the Sun.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: After the fall of the soviet union many countries remained in dispute in the early nineties despite eastern Europe‘s independence. In 1994 a bitter conflict broke out between the forces of the Chechen independence movement and the Russian regular army. Despite overwhelming manpower, weaponry and air support, the Russian forces were unable to establish effective permanent control over the mountainous area due to many successful Chechen guerrilla raids. Improvised Explosive Devices were one of the most effective methods employed in these disastrous raids and were the back drop to many Close Quarter Battle scenarios exchanged between the two sides.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. Once a princess who wasn't supposed to be queen, Elizabeth II led the country to thrive after World War II and became a steady presence in our changing world. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E06 - Lobster Poaching and Black Walnut
programme.desc: In "Lobster Poaching," a poacher has a bad day by jumping into the wrong boat. Meanwhile, "Black Walnut" tells a story about a surprising species that catches a Game Warden's attention. Game Wardens reminisce about unforgettable cases and experiences from their jobs.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E05 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 1
programme.desc: Hunters Adrian Knopps and Garrett Hagen venture into the remotest part of Alaska's Misty Fjord, hunting Moose and Bear. After a successful hunt Adrian finds himself trapped by a twenty foot tidal surge after Garrett fails to return with the skiff.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E06 - Stranded in the Alaska Wilderness Part 2
programme.desc: After a successful hunt., Adrian Knopps' hunting partner disappears taking their bear out to the boat. Now Adrian finds himself stranded on a tidal flat surround by bears and wolf packs and with massive storm bearing down on him. How will he survive?

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: In 1989, CIA operative Kurt Muse was imprisoned at the notorious Carcel Modelo in Panama for his role in organizing radio transmissions against dictator Manuel Noriega. That December, an elite group of the US Delta Force breached the roof of the prison, and one of the most daring close quarter battle operations in history began. From the dramatic helicopter crash and wounding of several Delta operators to the extraction of the entire team by the 5th Infantry Division, this is prime material for CQB analysis. In this episode, CQB recreates the raid, focusing on the “sub-second” reflexes of the Delta Force team from the moment they entered the prison to their extraction from the roof of the prison by an MH-6 “Little Bird” helicopter.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) is the elite Canadian Forces Special Operations unit responsible for a broad range of missions, including counter-terrorism and armed assistance to other government departments. Highly secretive, JTF 2 and its predecessor, the Canadian Airborne Regiment, have been deployed in hotspots around the world from Haiti to Bosnia. This episode focuses on the legendary JTF sniper teams and their use in Afghanistan alongside the British SAS and the US Delta Force at “the sharp end of the spear.” A book written by an ex-JTF member explains how, in 2006, both the Pentagon and the British Foreign Office noted the instrumental role that JTF 2 played in the rescue of the British and Canadian Christian Peacemaker Team held hostage in Iraq. Unique in look, the FN P90 personal defense weapon, used by JTF 2 soldiers and special police around the world, will be highlighted in this program.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: Falling Angels
programme.desc: Three female BASE jumpers trek deep into the Venezuelan jungle to attempt a historic jump from the world’s highest waterfall, facing extreme terrain, technical challenges, and one of the most dangerous exits in the sport.

programme.title: Gunnie Season
programme.desc: An extreme skiing film featuring some of the world’s top professional skiers pushing their limits on snow and steep terrain.

programme.title: Peace and Left
programme.desc: A surf series following Hugues Oyarzabal, capturing spectacular first-person barrel footage at iconic spots around the globe, offering a rare inside view of high-performance surfing.

programme.title: Pour Vous Servir
programme.desc: Or At Your Service in English takes you to the heart of the action, and most of all makes you feel how riders and cameramen share the same emotions. Like a collection of short stories, the movie tells how they live together and share the joys and the hassles of the everyday, the trips, the exhaustion, the laughter...

programme.title: IMAGENS DE MARCA
programme.desc: Programa: Imagens de Marca - S24 Alinhamento nº 43 Emissão de: 25 de outubro Tema: Portugal brinda-se no mundo SINOPSE DA EMISSÃO: Portugal, de forma geral, e a grande Lisboa, em particular, são cada vez mais reconhecidos a nível internacional como o cenário para congressos e convenções de empresas, mas também para outro tipo de eventos. É o caso da competição ASI Contest Best Sommelier of the World 2026 que decorreu em Cascais, Oeiras e Lisboa e que brinda ao arranque de mais uma emissão do Imagens de Marca. Fomos conhecer todo o projeto e como se organiza uma competição de grandes dimensões para eleger aquele que é considerado o melhor escanção do mundo. À mesa, degustamos vinhos, mas também tratamos da nossa saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida. E este foi o ponto de partida para a conferência “Comer Melhor” promovida pelo Continente no âmbito do Dia Mundial da Alimentação. Um momento que acompanhámos para refletir sobre os desafios e as oportunidades que estão a transformar o setor alimentar em Portugal. O setor inclui a restauração e esse foi o ponto de partida do negócio da Ticket, empresa presente em Portugal e que agora está a viver uma nova fase com uma identidade renovada e com um conjunto de serviços que acompanham as transformações do mundo do trabalho e as novas expectativas de empresas e colaboradores. Ainda nesta emissão fomos perceber como a Purina, marca que integra o portfolio da Nestlé, celebrou uma iniciativa que incentiva os colaboradores a levarem os animais de estimação para o local de trabalho e também como a iServices trabalha a experiência dos clientes num momento em que continua a crescer e a expandir a nível internacional.

programme.title: IMAGENS DE MARCA
programme.desc: Programa: Imagens de Marca - S24 Alinhamento nº 46 Emissão de: 15 novembro 2026 Tema: O futuro ganha lugar no quotidiano SINOPSE DA EMISSÃO: A tecnologia está a transformar a forma como vivemos, trabalhamos e nos deslocamos. Para as marcas, o desafio passa por tornar essa evolução relevante no quotidiano e fazer da inovação uma razão de escolha. Nesta emissão, o Imagens de Marca parte da Web Summit, que voltou a Lisboa em 2026, para descobrir como diferentes empresas procuram aproximar as suas soluções dos consumidores. Começamos com a Hisense, que se estreia no evento com um espaço próprio e apresenta a sua visão para o futuro da imagem e da casa conectada. Ainda na Web Summit, acompanhamos a iServices numa presença que cruza serviço, desenvolvimento tecnológico e procura de novas oportunidades de negócio. Além dos pontos de carregamento que disponibiliza aos visitantes, a marca apresenta a Bootly, uma aplicação que recorre à inteligência artificial para organizar contactos e informação recolhida em feiras. Vamos conhecer esta aposta e acompanhar as equipas que percorrem o evento à procura de tendências, fornecedores e caminhos para o crescimento. Da descoberta à experiência, seguimos para o Oeiras Parque, onde a Asus abriu uma loja temporária dedicada à nova gama Zenbook 14. Uma aposta que combina produto e comunicação para dar a conhecer os equipamentos e aproximar a marca do público português. Entramos depois numa casa conectada pela Samsung para explorar o conceito AI Living e perceber como a inteligência artificial e a aplicação SmartThings podem simplificar as rotinas e mudar a forma como interagimos com o espaço onde vivemos. Terminamos na estrada, com a Omoda Jaecoo e a sua expansão no mercado português. Entre tecnologia, design e diferentes soluções de motorização, vamos conhecer uma estratégia que procura conquistar notoriedade e confiança, apoiada numa rede de proximidade. Um percurso por diferentes setores, unidos pelo desafio de transformar inovação em experiências que façam sentido para as pessoas. ______________________________________________

programme.title: 60 MINUTOS
programme.desc: NOVO: PRESIDENTE TRUMP PT1: Após o resultado das eleições intercalares, o interesse jornalístico espalha-se naturalmente por alguns dos vencedores democratas que conseguiram proezas em bastiões republicanos. Mas é o principal derrotado que suscita ainda uma enorme curiosidade: o que tem o presidente Donald Trump a dizer sobre esta mudança da maré? PRESIDENTE TRUMP PT2: Com Donald Trump nunca faltam assuntos, nem respostas desconcertantes. Os próximos dois anos serão desafiantes na relação com o Congresso, na táctica para a guerra com o Irão ou a dança de palavras contraditórias sobre a Ucrânia. E, acima de tudo, a economia, o grande motor de vitórias e derrotas. FRANÇA DEBAIXO DE FOGO: Não, França não assiste apenas a uma revolta estudantil por melhores condições de ensino. E já nem é também sobre o custo de vida. O que se passa nas ruas, sem fim à vista, é muito mais. Há um nível de violência nos protestos que levanta dúvidas sobre infiltrados com a missão de manterem o país num estado de caos.

programme.title: Stingray Classic Rock
programme.desc: No puedes asignar un año a una canción de rock clásico. Simplemente sabes lo que es un clásico. Esta es la banda sonora de la vida de los jóvenes de corazón. Revive el sonido que revolucionó el mundo de la música, a través de las melodías de rock clásico desde finales de los sesenta hasta los ochenta. Obviamente hay mucho de Rolling Stones, Neil Young, Eric Clapton, Led Zeppelin, Tom Petty, Eagles, y más. Hay muchas estaciones de radio de ‘Rock Clásico’ en el dial, pero ninguna tan clásica como la de Stingray Music.

programme.title: Stingray Flashback 70s
programme.desc: Poliéster, plataformas, Studio 54, el poder de las flores y toda la extravagancia de los años 70. Retrocede a una de las décadas más explosivas de la historia de la música y revive las Noches de Boogie, Motown, Woodstock y más de los mejores momentos de 1968 a 1978. Comenzamos en el Verano del Amor y terminamos justo antes del amanecer del punk y la new wave. Explora este canal y disfruta de la música de: Abba, Jackson 5, Kool and the Gang, the Bee Gees, KC and the Sunshine Band, Carole King y más.

programme.title: Stingray Remember the 80s
programme.desc: Hay mucho que no olvidar. Revive la década que vio el nacimiento de los videos musicales y MTV, cuando la música pop estaba dominada por los sonidos electrónicos de los sintetizadores: Duran Duran, Michael Jackson, ABC, Human League, Soft Cell, Prince, Blondie, la temprana Madonna, The Police y más. No deberíamos tener que recordarte sobre el pop, la new wave y el mod, pero si lo has olvidado, sintoniza aquí para Recordar los '80s.

programme.title: Stingray Nothin' But 90s
programme.desc: Aquí es donde comienza a ponerse interesante de nuevo. Seattle se convierte en el terreno fértil para un nuevo estilo, un nuevo sonido. El grunge se expande mientras el pop aún reina. Realiza un viaje musical a través de la última década del siglo XX con esta mezcla cautivadora de éxitos pop y alternativos de los noventa, con artistas como Mariah Carey, U2, Tom Petty, Madonna y muchos más. Es difícil creer que 1990 fue hace casi 25 años, parece que fue solo ayer...

programme.title: Stingray Smooth Jazz
programme.desc: Los artistas de jazz contemporáneo más destacados en un paisaje sonoro fluido y suave, con guitarras melódicas y estilizadas, saxofones, pianos, trompetas. Crea un sonido de fondo excelente lleno de melodías y texturas modernas. Los artistas destacados incluyen a Boney James, Chris Botti, David Koz, Fourplay, Diana Krall, Warren Hill, George Howard, Jeff Lorber, Joe Sample, Kenny G, Spyro Gyra, Najee y Paul Hardcastle.

programme.title: Stingray Easy Listening
programme.desc: Para algunas melodías ligeras, relajantes y alegres, sintoniza lo mejor de la música de ambiente. Las melodías aquí son en su mayoría instrumentales, pero que no te sorprenda encontrar ocasionalmente esa canción atemporal con voces suaves, solo para añadirle variedad a este popular canal. Sintoniza este canal y déjalo todo el día para crear un ambiente de recuerdos y sonidos relajantes. Está concebido para satisfacer una gran variedad de gustos y para la gente que disfruta simplemente de la música ligera.
